'''High captain''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by the [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Ebruchi (fleet)|fleet]]. The Ebruchi known as "[[Common Cork]]," the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] armadas, was a high captain who served under the command of the Ebruchi [[Flux Screw fleet]]'s [[Unidentified Ebruchi chieftain|chieftain]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of high captain was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
